title: Digital identity overview

location.series: Jessie W. Lee / Verizon Master Brand Redesign

slide_intent: Compare the same identity across narrow interfaces so its recognizability can be assessed beyond a single logo.
strategic_value: Consistent typography and black-and-white fields can connect Verizon’s guidance, imagery and mobile layouts.
demonstration: A diagonal collage combines mobile guideline screens, a logo specimen, a typography specimen, photography and a voice example.
practical_value: Check whether type hierarchy and brand signatures remain coherent when content and screen proportions change.

content_islands.name: Tilted screen montage
content_islands.spec: Arrange the narrow screens at a shared diagonal on a dark gray field, preserving the gaps between them.

content_islands.name: Identity specimens
content_islands.spec: Keep logo, typography, lifestyle imagery and guidance examples visible as different parts of the same montage.

reference_purposes.Expression: The collage repeats bold sans-serif type, black and white fields, and small red logo accents.
reference_purposes.Application: The identity appears across mobile guideline navigation and content screens.
